Name: Ornithologist's Guild SVE and RSV Biomes Fix
Author: Vomau
Description:
[size=6][b][center][color=#ff0000]⚠️ This mod is no longer needed. ⚠️[/color][/center][/b][/size][b][center][size=4]Everything is now included in the original mod.[/size][/center][/b]


🔧 [u][b]Installation:[/b][/u]

[list=1]
[*]Download & Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14510]Ornithologist's Guild[/url]﻿
[*]Download this mod
[*]Open the Ornithologist's Guild folder and replace the default-biomes file
[*]Done - Have fun!
[/list]
⚠️ [u][b]Important:[/b][/u]

Since I couldn't find information on the individual biomes and all places, they may not be 100% accurate.
If another biome fits better with a location, let me know. If the mod creator adds the biome information to the original mod, this one is no longer needed.

📁 [b][u]Available files[/u][/b]

Ornithologist's Guild SVE and RSV Biomes Fix 1.0 includes biome information for Stardew Valley Expanded & Ridgeside Village.

Ornithologist's Guild Biomes Fix Extended 1.0 is made by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/155941813]ch0opera[/url] and also includes biome information for Magical Family; SVR3; Juna; Denver; Defense Division; Durin's Rest; Nikolai; Wayfarer; Aieysha; LASV; Tristan; Wilford; Zoro; Mermaid Island; Cowboy Life and Deep Woods.

Both files include vanilla Stardew Valley, Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village and East Scarp.
[b]You only need one of those two files.[/b]
